```{R}
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)

nodes <- read_csv("../network/nodes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
edges <- read_csv("../network/edges.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Verificar nós duplicados
nodes %>%
  dplyr::count(name) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

# Verificar arestas com nós inexistentes
setdiff(
  unique(c(edges$Source, edges$Target)),
  nodes$name
)

# Verificar tipos e camadas
table(nodes$type, nodes$layer)

# Contar NAs
colSums(is.na(edges))

colSums(is.na(nodes))


# Visualizar as linhas com NA
edges %>%
  filter(is.na(Source) | is.na(Target))

nodes %>%
  filter(is.na(name))
```

```{r}
edges <- edges %>%
  filter(!is.na(Source), !is.na(Target))

nodes <- nodes %>%
  filter(!is.na(name))

g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges,
  vertices = nodes %>% rename(name = name),
  directed = FALSE
)

# Remover loops e arestas duplicadas
g <- simplify(
  g,
  remove.multiple = TRUE,
  remove.loops = TRUE
)

vcount(g)
ecount(g)

table(V(g)$type, V(g)$layer)

components(g)$no
```

```{r}
comp <- components(g)

# Tamanho de cada componente
comp$csize

# Distribuição dos tipos de nós por componente
table(
  Component = comp$membership,
  Type = V(g)$type
)

# Listar os nós que não pertencem ao maior componente
main_comp <- which.max(comp$csize)

V(g)$name[comp$membership != main_comp]
```

```{r}
g_no_mdd <- delete_vertices(
  g,
  V(g)[type == "Disorder"]
)

vcount(g_no_mdd)
ecount(g_no_mdd)

table(V(g_no_mdd)$type, V(g_no_mdd)$layer)
components(g_no_mdd)$csize

# Identificar nós isolados após remover MDD
isolated <- V(g_no_mdd)[degree(g_no_mdd) == 0]

# Verificar os tipos
table(isolated$type)

# Listar os nomes
isolated$name

isolated_names <- isolated$name

# Vizinhos desses nós na rede original
neighbors_info <- purrr::map_dfr(isolated_names, function(n) {
  tibble(
    name = n,
    neighbors = paste(
      as_ids(neighbors(g, n)),
      collapse = "; "
    )
  )
})
```

````{r}
g_leiden <- delete_vertices(
  g_no_mdd,
  V(g_no_mdd)[degree(g_no_mdd) == 0]
)

# Conferir
vcount(g_leiden)
ecount(g_leiden)
components(g_leiden)$no

g_leiden_B <- induced_subgraph(
  g_leiden,
  vids = V(g_leiden)[type != "Pathway"]
)

new_ids <- c(
  "no7"  = "m4",
  "no12" = "m1",
  "no13" = "m2",
  "no17" = "m3",
  "no3"  = "m5"
)

idx <- V(g_leiden_B)$name %in% names(new_ids)

V(g_leiden_B)$name[idx] <- unname(
  new_ids[V(g_leiden_B)$name[idx]]
)

# Verificar estrutura
vcount(g_leiden_B)
ecount(g_leiden_B)

table(V(g_leiden_B)$type)
components(g_leiden_B)$csize

````

```{r}
library(mclust)
set.seed(123)
seeds <- sample.int(100000, 30)

partitions_B <- lapply(seeds, function(s) {
  set.seed(s)

  membership(cluster_leiden(
    g_leiden_B,
    objective_function = "modularity",
    resolution = 1,
    n_iterations = 10,
    weights = NA
  ))
})

ari_matrix_B <- outer(
  seq_along(partitions_B),
  seq_along(partitions_B),
  Vectorize(function(i, j) {
    adjustedRandIndex(
      partitions_B[[i]],
      partitions_B[[j]]
    )
  })
)

summary(ari_matrix_B[upper.tri(ari_matrix_B)])

# Frequência do número de comunidades
table(sapply(partitions_B, function(x) {
  length(unique(x))
}))
```

```{r}
library(purrr)

resolutions <- c(0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2)

results <- map_dfr(resolutions, function(res) {

  partitions <- lapply(seeds, function(s) {
    set.seed(s)

    membership(cluster_leiden(
      g_leiden_B,
      objective_function = "modularity",
      resolution = res,
      n_iterations = 10,
      weights = NA
    ))
  })

  # Modularidade convencional
  mods <- sapply(partitions, function(p) {
    modularity(g_leiden_B, p, weights = NA)
  })

  # Número de comunidades
  n_communities <- sapply(partitions, function(p) {
    length(unique(p))
  })

  # ARI entre todos os pares
  pairs <- combn(seq_along(partitions), 2)

  ari <- apply(pairs, 2, function(idx) {
    adjustedRandIndex(
      partitions[[idx[1]]],
      partitions[[idx[2]]]
    )
  })

  tibble(
    resolution = res,
    modularity_mean = mean(mods),
    modularity_sd = sd(mods),
    ari_mean = mean(ari),
    ari_median = median(ari),
    communities_mean = mean(n_communities),
    communities_min = min(n_communities),
    communities_max = max(n_communities)
  )
})

print(results, width = Inf)
```
```{r}
ggplot(results, aes(x = resolution, y = modularity_mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = modularity_mean - modularity_sd,
      ymax = modularity_mean + modularity_sd
    ),
    width = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = resolutions) +
  labs(
    x = "Resolution",
    y = "Mean modularity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Excluir autocomparações
diag(ari_matrix_B) <- NA

# ARI médio de cada partição em relação às demais
mean_ari <- rowMeans(ari_matrix_B, na.rm = TRUE)

# Partição mais representativa
best_idx <- which.max(mean_ari)

representative_B <- partitions_B[[best_idx]]

# Semente correspondente
seeds[best_idx]

# ARI médio da partição representativa
mean_ari[best_idx]

# Modularidade
modularity(g_leiden_B, representative_B, weights = NA)

# Tamanho das comunidades
table(representative_B)

# Composição das comunidades
table(
  Community = representative_B,
  Type = V(g_leiden_B)$type
)
```

```{R}
community_stability <- lapply(
  sort(unique(representative_B)),
  function(comm) {

    original_nodes <- which(representative_B == comm)

    jaccard <- sapply(partitions_B[-best_idx], function(p) {

      max(sapply(unique(p), function(c) {

        other_nodes <- which(p == c)

        length(intersect(original_nodes, other_nodes)) /
          length(union(original_nodes, other_nodes))

      }))
    })

    data.frame(
      Community = comm,
      Size = length(original_nodes),
      Jaccard_mean = mean(jaccard),
      Jaccard_median = median(jaccard),
      Jaccard_min = min(jaccard),
      Jaccard_sd = sd(jaccard)
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

community_stability
# c1 c2 e c4 para interpretacao biologica
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mimedb <- read_csv("mimedb.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
classyfire <- read_csv("classyfire.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

mets_merged <- mimedb |>
  left_join(classyfire, by = "InChIKey",
            na_matches = "never",
            suffix = c("_mimedb", "_classyfire"))

mets_merged <- mets_merged |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    Classification = {
      x <- str_trim(c_across(c(MiMeDB_classification, Kingdom:`Parent Level 4`)))
      paste(x[!is.na(x) & x != ""], collapse = "; ")
    }
  ) |>
  ungroup()

mets_merged <- mets_merged |>
  mutate(
    Classification = map_chr(Classification, function(x) {
      if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)

      x <- str_split(x, ";")[[1]]
      x <- str_to_lower(str_trim(x))
      x <- unique(x[x != ""])

      paste(x, collapse = "; ")
    })
  )

mets_classified <- mets_merged |>
  select(CID, Name, Classification) |>
  distinct()
```

```{R}
coverage <- mets_classified |>
  separate_rows(Classification, sep = ";") |>
  mutate(Classification = str_trim(Classification)) |>
  summarise(
    n_metabolites = n_distinct(CID),
    n_classified = n_distinct(
      CID[!is.na(Classification) & Classification != ""]
    ),
    n_classes = n_distinct(
      Classification[!is.na(Classification) & Classification != ""]
    ),
    coverage = 100 * n_classified / n_metabolites
  )



class_frequency <- metabolite_classes |>
  filter(!is.na(Classification), Classification != "") |>
  group_by(Classification) |>
  summarise(
    n_metabolites = n_distinct(CID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_metabolites))

class_frequency |>
  slice_max(n_metabolites, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(Classification, n_metabolites),
    y = n_metabolites
  )) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Metabolite classification",
    y = "Number of metabolites"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
eligible_classes <- class_frequency |>
  filter(
    n_metabolites >= 3,
    Classification != "Unclassified"
  ) |>
  pull(Classification)

metabolite_classes_filtered <- metabolite_classes |>
  filter(Classification %in% eligible_classes)
```

```{R}
universe <- metabolite_classes |>
  distinct(CID, community)

enrichment <- expand_grid(
  community = sort(unique(universe$community)),
  Classification = eligible_classes
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    class_members = list(
      unique(metabolite_classes$CID[
        metabolite_classes$Classification == Classification
      ])
    ),

    a = sum(universe$community == community &
              universe$CID %in% class_members),
    b = sum(universe$community == community) - a,
    c = length(class_members) - a,
    d = nrow(universe) - a - b - c,

    expected = (a + b) * (a + c) / nrow(universe),
    fold_enrichment = a / expected,

    p_value = fisher.test(
      matrix(c(a, b, c, d), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
      alternative = "greater"
    )$p.value
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-class_members) |>
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  ) |>
  arrange(p_adj, p_value)
```

```{R}
enrichment |>
  filter(p_adj < 0.05) |>
  select(
    community, Classification, a, expected,
    fold_enrichment, p_value, p_adj
  ) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
jaccard_comparison <- expand_grid(
  Leiden = sort(unique(representative_B)),
  Louvain = sort(unique(representative_louvain))
) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    nodes_leiden = list(which(representative_B == Leiden)),
    nodes_louvain = list(which(representative_louvain == Louvain)),

    Jaccard = length(intersect(nodes_leiden, nodes_louvain)) /
              length(union(nodes_leiden, nodes_louvain))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-nodes_leiden, -nodes_louvain)

best_matches <- jaccard_comparison |>
  group_by(Leiden) |>
  slice_max(Jaccard, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

best_matches
```
